The league season had two champions, with [[Club Atlético River Plate|River Plate]] winning the Apertura (26th. league title for the club), while [[San Lorenzo de Almagro|San Lorenzo]] won the Clausura championship (12th. league title). [[Gimnasia y Esgrima de Jujuy]] (as champion of [[1993–94 Primera B Nacional]]) and [[Talleres de Córdoba]] (winner of "Torneo Octogonal" after beating [[Instituto de Córdoba|Instituto]])[https://www.lavoz.com.ar/deportes/futbol/hoy-se-cumplen-19-anos-de-la-final-que-talleres-le-gano-instituto-por-el-ascenso-primera/ Hoy se cumplen 19 años de la final que Talleres le ganó a Instituto por el ascenso a Primera], La Voz, 6 Aug 2013 promoted from the [[Primera B Nacional]] (second division). On the other hand, [[Deportivo Mandiyú]] and Talleres (Córdoba) were relegated to Primera B Nacional.[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/arg95.html Argentina 1994/95] by Pablo Ciullini on the RSSSF"Argentina: 1ra.
